YouTube title seed: Why Does the Jet Bridge Keep Moving?
YouTube description seed: Next time you board, look for the little wheel by the door. Did you ever feel the bridge move? #TellMeWhyyyyyy #Shorts
The central fact: The bridge follows the plane up and down, so its floor stays level with the door.
The later surprise: A wheel on the bridge rests on the plane and tells it when to move.

facts.statement: In the US, a jet bridge attached to a plane must have an automatic leveler that follows the plane up and down as it is loaded and unloaded, keeping the floor level with the door sill.
A small wheel on the bridge rests against the plane's body; as the plane rises or sinks, the wheel turns and the bridge moves to match.
Passengers, bags and fuel change the plane's weight at the gate, and that makes it slowly rise or settle; you can sometimes feel the bridge give a small jolt as it adjusts.
